transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the readiness huddle for this Saturday's Cell 4 production window. We have a ten-hour window available, and it cannot be extended because the cell is reserved for sanitation afterward. We have two campaigns awaiting assignment — Campaign M and Campaign N. Campaign M has the higher customer priority, and Campaign N can be moved to next week's planned capacity if needed. I'll be making the final decision on the campaign assignment and operating controls after we hear from each area. Let's go through the standard reports — maintenance, quality, logistics, and safety. Please share your applicable constraints one at a time.
